questions.questionText: In an experiment to determine the acceleration of free fall g, a ball-bearing is held by an electromagnet. When the current to the electromagnet is switched off, a clock starts and the ball- bearing falls. After falling a distance h, the ball-bearing strikes a switch to stop the clock which measures the time t of the fall. Which expression can be used to calculate the value of g? ht2 th2 2t 2h

options.A: B C D

Then it moves back to Y and comes to rest momentarily somewhere on XY. X Y Z Which velocity-time graph represents the motion of the ball? velocity

options.A: 0 0 time velocity

options.A: The man has a mass on Mars of 60N.
options.B: The man has a mass on the Moon of 120kg.
options.C: The man weighs 120N on the Moon.
options.D: The man weighs 240N on the Moon.

questions.questionText: A student is studying Brownian motion. Using a microscope, she observes particles of smoke in a glass container, illuminated by a strong light. The particles of smoke have a zig-zag path, constantly changing speed and direction. What happens to the smoke particles if the air in the container is heated?

options.A: The smoke particles become easier to see.
options.B: The smoke particles change direction more frequently.
options.C: The smoke particles increase in volume.
options.D: The smoke particles move further apart.
